bullets: Cowboys Offensive Surge: Fresh off moving to 8-1 (1st in NFC West) with a 46–40 win over Dallas, San Francisco piled up 584 total yards [49ers.com Official](https://www.49ers.com/news/power-rankings-where-the-49ers-stand-entering-week-11) [NFL Trade Rumors](https://nfltraderumors.co/nfc-notes-christan-mccaffrey-christian-parker-49ers-cowboys-giants/). Pass-Rush & Front Review: San Francisco generated just 1 sack against Dallas, with Kyle Shanahan pointing to fourth-quarter defensive-line fatigue after the front graded solidly early [49ers Webzone](https://www.49erswebzone.com/articles/205254-romello-height-spark-49ers-pass/) [49ers on NBCSBA](https://www.nbcsportsbayarea.com/nfl/san-francisco-49ers/overreactions-nick-bosa-dallas-cowboys/1980829/).

Injury & Practice Status: Entering Week 11 preparation, head coach Kyle Shanahan and the medical staff evaluate WR Mike Evans (Achilles) and CB Renardo Green (back) ahead of Wednesday's initial participation report [Nick Wagoner](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50502440/san-francisco-49ers-mike-evans-achilles-tendinitis-injury-recovery) [Jennifer Lee Chan](https://www.nbcsportsbayarea.com/nfl/san-francisco-49ers/deommodore-lenoir-renardo-green-injuries-cowboys/1980819/). DT C.J. West (knee) and CB Nate Hobbs (groin) continue ramping inside active 21-day Injured Reserve practice windows toward potential 53-man roster activation.
